scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/audit/generated && cp src/audit/generated/station.did.js dist/audit/generated/
scripts.generate-station-types: didc bind --target ts ../core/station/api/spec.did > ./src/audit/generated/station.did.d.ts && didc bind --target js ../core/station/api/spec.did | sed -E 's/^export const ([a-zA-Z_]+)/exports.\1/g' > ./src/audit/generated/station.did.js && cp ../core/station/api/spec.did ./src/audit/generated/station.did
